messages:
Jamal: FYI — after last night's 02:10 spike we got a bunch of repeat pages from replica-tilt (same host, different alerts). Looks like dedupe didn't catch them.
Lina: Ugh. I thought the dedupe rule covered that. Any quick evidence from logs?
Jamal: Logs show repeated 'kv-eviction' failures plus flapping network errors. Pager spam was ~8 messages over 4m for the same box.
Marie: That's the pattern we've seen 3x now this month — short network blips + low threshold on replica-tilt causing immediate paging.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-2406 — linked to thread
Kevin: Can we tweak dedupe window or raise threshold? Current rule: dedupe_window=60s, threshold=1
Jamal: I propose: dedupe_window -> 300s, threshold -> 2, and add an aggregated check across host groups. Quick experiment tonight?
Lina: Agree with experiment. We should also add a short suppression when network error rate spikes but system still healthy.
Marie: Action items:
 - Jamal: prototype dedupe_window=300s + threshold=2 on staging by EOD today
 - Kevin: draft paging policy change (reduce immediate pages for infra alerts) by tomorrow PR
 - Lina: update postmortem with recurring-pattern notes + link to tests by Friday
sre-bot: @Jamal assigned to INC-2026-2406
Jamal: Test plan I'm going to run:
```
# simulate 6 alerts over 5 minutes on staging
for i in {1..6}; do curl -X POST /fake-alert -d '{"alert":"replica-tilt"}'; sleep 50; done
```
Kevin: For the paging policy, thinking: 1) add 5m aggregation for infra alerts, 2) escalate to oncall only if total failures >3 across hosts in 5m.
Lina: Good. Also let's not hide real emergent issues — keep an emergency bypass (pager if error rate >15% for >2m).
Marie: Timeline: small staging test tonight, prod rollout of dedupe + threshold on Monday 09:00 PT if green. Paging policy PR by Tue COB. Postmortem update and follow-up review Wed ops sync.
Jamal: I'll post results here after staging run. If tests pass, I'll open the prod rollout ticket and ping @oncall.
Lina: Thanks. One more: add an eval to Redwood Optimize to flag recurring 'replica-tilt' incidents across 30d window — helps catch pattern early.
Kevin: I'll add that to the ticket.
Marie: Thanks team :thumbsup:
Jamal: leaving notes in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-2406
sre-bot: incident status changed: triage -> action_in_progress
